statement: On a leftover AboveAnchor Q-orbit there is an exact scale section S_n(α)={x : n <= x and x^A < n^B} such that every first return satisfies R_S(x) < x or R_S(x) = x. False. For α in {9/4, 8/3, 3} every leftover defined return has tau_S = 1, so R_S is Q. For α = 3/2 the 365 returns 365 -> 763 -> 1749 -> 4447 are strictly ascending and not recurrent; only the later excursion 4447 -> 1196 descends. Section record-lows fail: the minimum visit stays n. This is not ReturnBelow, not a Q-descriptor, and not a halt theorem.
